notes: Occasions as data — runtime/occasion_engine.py resolves these daily; nothing duck- or occasion-specific is hardcoded in flows. rule.type: 'fixed' (month/day), 'nth_weekday' (month, weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun, nth), or 'fixed_dates' (explicit ISO date list for holidays with no simple rule, e.g. Easter — extend the list before it runs out). lead_days: how many days before the peak the occasion becomes active. keywords: lowercase substrings matched against product tags (supporting signal; the primary signal is theme_classification.occasions from the classifier — keep occasion id in sync with theme_taxonomy.json occasions for occasions that should get the strong classifier signal). etsy_tag_candidates: each MUST be 6-20 chars (Etsy tag rule; enforced by test). messaging_phases: first entry whose max_days_until_peak >= days_until_peak wins, ordered ascending.
